title: The Course of Plain Dealing
summary: A course in fighting without feints or disguise so that every strike and guard is exactly what it shows and is hard to answer.

title: A Course in Dissolving Illusions
summary: A course in breaking small illusions and false glows and clearing befuddled minds with a firm touch of clear qi.

title: The Second Primer of Lie Sensing
summary: A second primer for students who can already read a face; it trains the qi sense to feel a lie as a tremor in the air.

title: Course of Forced Acknowledgment
summary: A course in pressing a foe's mind until he sees his true plight and can no longer pretend that the fight is going well.
